query: Pull up everything we talked about with the Dyson PencilVac

legend.0: Direct: the format acts on the words alone: a search, a question to answer, a picture, a site by name, videos, something seen before. "capital of peru", "go to youtube", "pictures of it", "wait no I meant brazil".
legend.1: A value must be read out of the words first and passed along: a number, a name, a setting, a place, a time. "set the thermostat to 68", "remind me at 7", "translate this to spanish".
legend.2: Several steps, a condition or a schedule: an "and then", an "if", a "when", an "every", or a comparison across several things. "find the cheapest flight and book it", "if it rains tomorrow move my run to the evening".
